details.description: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 is Alibaba's Qwen team's updated reasoning-focused release of its 235-billion-parameter (22B active) mixture-of-experts model, published under the Apache 2.0 license. It runs exclusively in thinking mode with, per its model card, an increased thinking length compared with the original hybrid Qwen3-235B-A22B, and is described as delivering significantly improved performance on reasoning tasks and markedly better general capabilities than its predecessor. It natively supports 262,144 tokens of context, extendable to about 1,000,000 tokens using Dual Chunk Attention and MInference sparse attention, and supports agentic tool-calling.
advantages: Scores 92.3 on AIME25 and 74.1 on LiveCodeBench v6, per its model card.
Scores 84.4 on MMLU-Pro and 81.1 on GPQA, per its model card.
Scores 79.7 on Arena-Hard v2 and 71.9 on BFCL-v3 for agentic tool-calling, per its model card.
Natively supports 262,144 tokens of context, extendable to about 1,000,000 tokens using Dual Chunk Attention and MInference sparse attention, per its model card.
disadvantages: Runs exclusively in thinking mode and cannot switch to a fast non-thinking mode, unlike the original hybrid Qwen3-235B-A22B.
use_cases: Complex step-by-step reasoning in math, coding and logic.
Graduate-level knowledge and reasoning question answering.
Agentic tool-calling workflows that benefit from extended reasoning.
Long-context analysis spanning hundreds of thousands of tokens.

notes: Native context (262,144 tokens) matches the catalog facts exactly. Additional benchmark entries on the card (HMMT25, SuperGPQA, MultiIF, MMLU-ProX, INCLUDE, PolyMATH, plus non-accuracy metrics like CFEval rating) were left out of evaluations as either redundant or not accuracy-style scores.
